edition.check: 5: INPUT contains barcode + matches >=2 independent sources -> NOT MET (no barcode in input, FACTS input_has_barcode=false). 4: Without barcode, title, artist, format and >=1 further attribute unambiguous in >=2 sources and no competing edition with different tracklist -> NOT MET (input omits artist and any further attribute, and competing MC editions with different tracklists exist in tl-discogs search). 3: Unambiguous or all fitting editions share the same tracklist -> NOT MET (discogs:release/8491193 'Various - Ich Sag's Dir Mit Musik' 5xCassette fits title and MC format with a completely different tracklist, and discogs:release/7800803 is also an MC compilation starting with the same title). 2: Several editions fit the input and at least one has a DIFFERENT tracklist; choice rests on weak signals -> MET (both Kastelruther Spatzen MC releases such as discogs:release/2297987 and Various Artists 5xMC compilation discogs:release/8491193 fit the title-and-MC-only input with different tracklists; the agent relied on the sample ID 'spatzen-mc-titleonly' and an unstated assumption that a solo album was meant).
edition.summary: Because the input provides only title and MC format without an artist, the Various Artists 5xMC compilation discogs:release/8491193 also fits the input with a completely different tracklist.

tracklist.summary: For the selected Kastelruther Spatzen MC edition, MusicBrainz, Discogs, and both J-card scans agree on all 12 track positions, order, and titles up to minor spelling variants.

durations.check: 100% of tracks have a duration, 83% confirmed by >= 2 sources, 2 conflicts
durations.summary: 100% of tracks have a duration, 83% confirmed by >= 2 sources, 2 conflicts

sources.check: 5: Database + independent primary source (read cover/booklet/label print, label or manufacturer information) of the same edition -> MET (musicbrainz:release/e0d210c6-ca75-3482-bff4-f33715a070c3 has no cover images and differing duration/catno details, and is paired with tl-vision readings of the physical J-card inner and back prints of the same edition from Discogs images, which are independent of MusicBrainz and even correct the Discogs text entry's 3:03 error on A6, alongside independent database entry discogs:release/2297987 and deezer:album/231158).
sources.summary: The agent combined two independent databases (MusicBrainz and Discogs) with tl-vision readings of the original J-card inner and back prints of the exact MC edition.

concerns: Disambiguation relied on external task metadata ('spatzen-mc-titleonly') rather than the input itself; given only title and format 'MC', the Various Artists 5xMC compilation discogs:release/8491193 also matches the input with a completely different tracklist.
Validation error reported in FACTS: the top-level 'artists' array is empty/missing instead of listing 'Kastelruther Spatzen'.
